proposed_from.topic: Rectangular all-resolution common-half-sum frontier for exact two-sided-market randomization inference. For independently and uniformly half-randomized populations B and S of sizes 2n_B and 2n_S, optimize F(a,b)=sum_l a_l b_l over covering paired rectangular partitions with at least R common half-sum assignments. For every R>=4, prove that when n_B,n_S>=4R every optimizer belongs to the explicit finite residual catalog C_R with residual totals at most 2R; derive the exact affine phase formula and all equality cases, and give certified finite enumeration below the threshold. Construct the constant-incidence Z-then-P sampler and exact one-sided inversion under the sharp constant total-effect null using null-adjusted focal outcomes. Keep weak-null, two-sided-95-percent-at-R=20, power-optimality, and unrestricted-biclique claims out of scope. Consumer: Ye et al. Management Science 2023 Platform O experiment, which independently randomized unequal user-view and ad populations with balanced treatment/control within each experimental side. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: A two-stage concentration proof was derived: a unit-residual benchmark forces buyer residual A<=R, and a support-preserving residual-copy competitor gives (n_B-2A+1)D<=(n_B-1)A and D<2A<=2R. Exact catalog, incidence, inversion, aspect-ratio, and threshold audits found no counterexample; small-margin universal uniqueness, raw-outcome conditioning, and ordinary two-sided 95-percent inversion at support 20 were checked and excluded. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Independently verify H(a,b')=H(a) for the residual-copy competitor and the positive-loss inequality without assuming an ordering of seller coordinates. EARLY KILL TEST: Reproduce the 136 residual-copy checks and all 2,628 feasible C_4 targets at (n_B,n_S)=(16,17); any support-loss counterexample or outside-catalog optimizer stops the field launch. seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction, Definition 3.1, Procedure 3.2, Theorem 3.2, Section 3.3.2, Appendix B.1, and the Conclusion were inspected in arXiv:2504.06215v2.
seed_details.question: Does every retention-maximizing covering rectangle with at least \(R\) common half-sum assignments admit a residual representation whose two residual totals are bounded only by \(R\), uniformly over rectangular aspect ratios?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the equal-square block calculation after Liu, Shaikh, and Toulis's Theorem 3.2 by a two-margin concentration argument; the first new step is a support-preserving copy of the smaller-side residual profile onto the larger side.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for rectangular common-half-sum optimization, paired subset-sum profiles, and two-sided conditional-randomization rectangles found biclique heuristics and equal-block constructions but no exact coupled frontier.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that the result is immediate from the \(k\)-block calculation in Liu, Shaikh, and Toulis because only the number of blocks matters.
seed_details.rebuttal: Unequal paired block sizes create a coupled bivariate coefficient problem; their calculation neither bounds both residual margins nor classifies equality cases across arbitrary aspect ratios.

seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 1.2, its pure-profile decomposition in Lemma 2.2, the equality propagation in Claims 2.3--2.4, and the asymmetric discussion in Sections 3--4 were inspected in arXiv:1912.02886v2.
seed_details.question: Can every active residual catalog element be purified to a diagonal unit residual without reducing common support or retention, yielding a closed formula for every \(R\)?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Singhal purifies each one-dimensional subset-sum profile separately and then uses bilinearity; here the first altered step must preserve one common two-dimensional fiber while improving a constrained bilinear retention score.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing unit-residual purification with fixed-cardinality bivariate subset sums found no theorem treating simultaneous buyer and seller targets.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that all unit residuals follow immediately from the classical Erd\H{o}s--Littlewood--Offord extremizer.
seed_details.rebuttal: That theorem maximizes one point mass without two covering constraints or a paired retention objective; even Singhal's pure objects do not preserve a specified common bivariate fiber.

seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Theorem 1, Definitions 1--3, Lemmas D.1--D.2, the proof of Theorem 1, and the Discussion were inspected in arXiv:1904.02308v3.
seed_details.question: Can an outcome-free two-stage sampler represent every admissible assignment equally often for unequal paired block shapes?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The group-action proof maps equal-probability fibers bijectively; the rectangular sampler instead begins by counting the labeled partition fiber over each assignment and showing that the count is constant.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for constant-incidence paired-partition samplers under two-sided complete randomization found orbit and mirror-allocation arguments but no unequal rectangular fiber formula.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that uniformity is a direct corollary of orbit--stabilizer.
seed_details.rebuttal: Equivariance alone does not equalize a many-to-one auxiliary partition kernel; the required constant fiber count is an additional combinatorial identity.

seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Definitions 2 and 6, Theorem 1, Proposition 2, the proof of Theorem 1, and the Discussion were inspected in arXiv:2004.08472.
seed_details.question: Does null adjustment turn the discrete one-sided randomization inversion over each rectangular support into an explicit order-statistic confidence ray?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Before Luo et al.'s monotone inversion can be used, the dyadic focal array must be shown imputable assignment by assignment after the conditioning partition is selected.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for Fisher inversion with two-sided dyadic exposures found general effect-increasing inversion but no crossing formula for block-varying focal denominators.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that this is immediate from Luo et al.'s Proposition 2.
seed_details.rebuttal: The general endpoint theorem does not supply dyadic imputability, the strict positivity of every crossing denominator, or the exact order-statistic endpoint under rectangular conditioning.

seed_details.anchor_read: Definition 2.1, Example 2.2, the equal-block total-effect construction, its proof, and the Conclusion were inspected in arXiv:2504.06215v2.
seed_details.question: For arbitrary fixed treated counts, is there a finite allocation-ratio phase classification, or can one identify the first regime where bounded residuals fail?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The complementation reduction that makes every support fiber even fails before residual concentration begins; it must be replaced by coupled fixed-cardinality subset-sum profiles.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining non-half two-sided complete randomization with coupled subset-sum extremizers found Liu et al.'s general design, Li et al.'s allocation trade-off, and Singhal's one-profile asymmetry, but no exact rectangular frontier.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that replacing half sums by treated-count sums is a routine parameter extension.
seed_details.rebuttal: Complement symmetry, equal fiber weights, and the support-preserving copy all fail at the first reduction, so the destination requires a different extremal object rather than a parameter substitution.

seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Theorem 3.2 and its proof in Appendix B.1, Section 3.3.2, and the Conclusion were inspected in arXiv:2504.06215v2.
seed_details.question: What is the smallest universal threshold \(N_R^\star\) above which a bounded-residual catalog captures all optimizers?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The coarse benchmark concentration inequality must be made sharp enough to track the first margin at which each residual obstruction disappears.
seed_details.destination_search: No source located a minimal threshold for paired common-half-sum rectangles; the available papers optimize neither this restricted objective nor its equality boundary.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that \(N_R^\star\) is just a finite-computation after the catalog theorem.
seed_details.rebuttal: For all \(R\), necessity and sufficiency of the threshold require a structural family of boundary obstructions, not enumeration at fixed \(R\).

seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Theorems 2--3, Sections 4--5, the proof of Theorem 2, and the computational appendix were inspected in arXiv:1910.10862.
seed_details.question: Can every below-threshold paired-profile optimum be certified in pseudo-polynomial time in the two margins?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic NP-hard biclique search by coefficient dynamic programming over structured covering compositions.
seed_details.destination_search: Standard subset-sum dynamic programming handles a fixed profile, while no source found optimizes over all paired compositions with a compact certificate.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that the claim is standard dynamic programming.
seed_details.rebuttal: That objection defeats the fixed-profile version, and the all-profile optimization lacks enough evidence for a theorem-level econometric kernel.

seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, Theorems 3.1--3.2, Remark 3.2, the proof in Appendix B.1, the arbitrary-design sampling discussion, and the Conclusion were inspected in arXiv:2504.06215v2.
seed_details.question: Can a weighted-incidence partition kernel reproduce nonuniform independent two-sided designs conditional on rectangular events without rejection sampling?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The constant-fiber Bayes cancellation must be replaced by a weighted transport identity matching the original assignment mass on every fiber.
seed_details.destination_search: The inspected conditioning-mechanism and orbit papers provide validity once the conditional law is known, but no closed rectangular transport kernel for nonexchangeable side designs was found.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that importance sampling from the conditional law settles the problem.
seed_details.rebuttal: Importance weights do not provide an exact rejection-free sampler or a finite fiber certificate, but the kernel would require assumptions on design weights outside the present scope.

seed_details.anchor_read: The Introduction, two-sided setup, Theorem 3.2 and its proof, and the Conclusion's call for more complex interaction structures were inspected in arXiv:2504.06215v2.
seed_details.question: For three independently half-randomized populations, can a bounded-residual catalog optimize the tensor retention score \(\sum_\ell a_\ell b_\ell d_\ell\) at a common support floor?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The bilinear rearrangement and two-stage concentration fail when the objective becomes trilinear, before any residual-copy comparison can be applied.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for tensor common-half-sum randomization frontiers and three-sided marketplace conditional tests found no matching target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that this is a speculative dimensional lift without an economic design in view.
seed_details.rebuttal: The trilinear obstruction is genuine, but the absence of a verified consumer and a viable concentration lemma makes the seed premature.
